verdict.rationale: Firebase's own docs describe several official SDKs: the Firebase Authentication SDK with sign-in and user-management methods, the Admin SDK, the Firebase Test SDK for Node.js unit tests, and Firebase AI Logic client-side for Android, iOS, Flutter, Unity and web apps. Community users also praise its free libraries and AngularFire. Missing for 10: a consolidated SDK reference showing language/platform coverage and versioning, any AI-native SDK affordances (no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec was found), and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
